Only 22% of remote job listings on Loker Dollar show a salary. The rest are marked DOE—here's what that means for your USD job search.

DOE stands for 'determined on experience.' Employers use it to keep pay flexible, but it can work in your favor if you know how to negotiate.

Key data from our latest analysis of 4,280 active listings:
• 22% (940) disclose a salary
• 78% (3,340) leave pay blank (DOE)
• 64% (2,735) accept applicants from any country
• 1,213 new listings in the last 7 days

Real example: Online Consumer Panels America pays $25–$45/hour for product assessments—no experience needed.

DOE isn't always a red flag. In fields like AI or specialized medical roles, it can push salaries above market averages. Use it as a negotiation lever.

Ready to find DOE roles that match your skills? Browse the latest listings on Loker Dollar and start the conversation today.
